result.rationale: Diff shows `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` followed by `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"` without optional chaining. When evt.destinationCalendar is null/undefined, mainHostDestinationCalendar is undefined and the `.integration` dereference throws a TypeError, whereas old code used `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration`. This is a real regression for Meet bookings with no destination calendar.
